Subject: Next-term orientation and burst checkpoint

Hi Rajesh —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As we kick off the renewal conversation for LumenAI, I wanted to lay out a short orientation and propose a lightweight timeline so your team can plan staffing for the upcoming seasonal burst. High level: confirm term start, agree on burst headroom, and lock a QBR to align execs and ops.

Proposed 2–3 week timeline (flexible):
- Week 1: Mutual action plan draft + capacity ask (we sent a first draft attached)
- Week 2: Pricing & SLA alignment + internal approvals
- Week 3: Execute amendments (term changes / burst addendum) + QBR

Can you confirm the expected peak TPS and average seq length we should model for the burst? That will help Marissa and Karthik size a short-term bridge and give an upfront cost estimate.

QBR poll: please pick any slots that work for your exec + ops (short preferences below):
- Tue Sep 2, 10–11am PT
- Wed Sep 3, 1–2pm PT
- Thu Sep 4, 9–10am PT

Attachments: Lumen_MutualActionDraft_v1.pdf (mutual action plan), capacity_estimates.xlsx (template you can fill)

Next steps from our side: Marissa will coordinate scheduling and Karthik will draft the burst pricing options.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: for the upcoming marketing ramp our preliminary estimate is 12–14k concurrent tokens/sec peak (short peaks of ~45–60s) and avg sequence length ~110 tokens. We'll confirm with telemetry this afternoon and update the attached template.

The Sep 3 slot (1–2pm PT) looks best for our exec + ops. A couple of asks from our procurement/legal team:
- Can you share a one-page summary of the burst pricing bands (e.g., up to X tokens/hr, X–Y tier pricing, overage handling)?
- We also need to know if Redwood can accommodate an 8-week commitment on the burst addendum vs the default 12-week — that's something our finance team prefers.

I'll fill the capacity_estimates.xlsx and send back by EOD.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Director, Platform Ops
LumenAI
